title: Cloudstitch · 봉쇄자의 공중 요새

source.method: original code-authored volumetric architecture and vertex painting

semantic_groups.description: 겹 판금·황동 리벳·하부 용골을 가진 먹색의 부유 선체
크림색 수선 천과 조임 띠가 있는 하부 부력낭
열린 철제 우리와 커다란 황동 종, 층진 첨탑
가시 난간과 독립 실루엣을 가진 여섯 개의 경계 함포
그을린 공장 굴뚝과 배관, 황동 팬과 압력통
독창적인 봉쇄 매듭 문양과 꿰맨 가장자리를 가진 굴곡 천

appearance.surfaces: matte vertex-painted metal, plaster, canvas and timber
appearance.palette: soot navy armor, weathered teal roofs, brass trim, cream quilted buoyancy, oxblood banners, warm amber windows
appearance.material: glTF metallic-roughness, roughness 1, metalness 0; review can replace with hand-painted unlit or toon shading
appearance.runtime: Outline and cel shading belong to review runtime; they are not automatically reproduced by importing the GLB into an engine.

limitations: Art review prototype only; no gameplay or enemy AI.
No authored collision, LOD, navmesh, engine sockets, gameplay statistics or destruction.
Static geometry; no rig or animation; the crane, bell, banners and cannons are modeled in a fixed pose.
Building interiors are not authored; open gate is represented by a closed portcullis.
